sections.title: UESUGI U-BROS-25
sections.overview: A tweeter system that combines a power amplifier and an electronic crossover network in addition to a dedicated tweeter.The electronic crossover network is a two stage CR-type filter with a good connection between the low-frequency and high-frequency sides.Since the signal output on the low frequency side is high impedance, a cathode follower feed amplifier using a vacuum tube is installed to prevent external noise including hum components from entering.All the amplifiers are vacuum tube type, and all the vacuum tubes used are select tubes manufactured in the heyday of vacuum tubes.The 6L6GC power tube is made by GE Corporation of the United States, and the 6189 driver tube (highly reliable 12AU7/ECC82 tube) is supplied to the United States Army.The first stage of the power amplifier section is ECC83/12AX7, and the driver and phase inverter stage is a 6189 type cathode coupling type. By directly coupling the first stage with the driver and phase inverter stage, the time constant in the low frequency range is eliminated and excellent low frequency transient characteristics are obtained.The power stage is a 6L6GC self-bias system ultra linear connection push-pull system designed to provide stable operation over a long period of time.The tweeter section of the U ? BROS-25 has an impedance of 8  . However, considering the case where the U ? BROS-25 is set to the full range and a full-range speaker is connected, the output matching impedance is set to 4   and 16   in addition to 8  .As with other Uesugi amplifiers, we use transformers jointly developed with tamura Manufacturing.The output transformer is designed with excellent phase characteristics, and the negative feed back is connected to the cathode of the first stage from the exclusive winding, so the operation is stable.The power transformer is completely sealed with a short ring and a ham proof belt to prevent leakage flux.As for the chassis, after bending a 1.6 mm thick high-grade steel plate, solder is poured into all the welded parts and polished to create the rounded corners of the four corners.The bonnet cover is also treated in the same way.In consideration of the unique noise generated when a printed circuit board is used, no printed circuit board is used for the wiring, and the wiring is done manually by veteran craftsmen.The tweeter section is equipped with a 3 cm soft dome type tweeter made by Dinavio.This unit has excellent directional characteristics, similar response curves for on-axis 0  , 30  , and 60   characteristics, excellent distortion factor characteristics, and wide range.Although a cabinet is not required for operation, it is contained in a special cabinet for stable setting. This cabinet is designed for high mechanical strength and uses solid walnut as a surface treatment material.The front net can be attached and removed, but tuning is done with net.To connect the U ? BROS-25, first connect the output signal from the preamplifier to the input of the amplifier section of the U ? BROS-25 using a pin cord, and then connect the low-frequency output signal of the U ? BROS-25 to the input of the power amplifier using a pin cord and to the main speaker.The tweeter section of the U ? BROS-25 is connected to the 8   output terminal of the amplifier section with a speaker cable.The amplifier section of the U ? BROS-25 is equipped with a frequency range selector. In normal use, the high position provides a low-cut output signal.When this position is set to the full position, it outputs the whole band like a general power amplifier, so if you connect the tweeter section of the U ? BROS-25, it will be damaged.If you are using a power amp, set the level control to the maximum value, and adjust the volume with the U ? BROS-25 level control.If the high range is insufficient even if the U ? BROS-25 level control is set to the maximum value, set the U ? BROS-25 level control to the maximum value and adjust the power amp level control.

sections.title: UESUGI U-BROS-20
sections.overview: This phono equalizer amplifier was developed as a continuing product in consideration of increased production due to the popularity of the limited sale UTY-7.Taking advantage of the results obtained in the development of the UTY-7, the fully independent power supply and amplifier are combined into a single chassis.The dimensions and shape are the same as those of the paired preamp U ? BROS-28. Even if you set the U ? BROS-28 so that it is close to the U ? BROS-28, such as placing it on or under the U ? BROS-28, the hum will not be pulled or the sound will not become muddy.All parts such as resistors and condensers are designed for sound quality and standardized.In the latter half of the 1965 s, the K. Electron Tube Division of Matsushita Electric Industrial Co., Ltd. used special tubes for the Uesugi Research Laboratory, instead of those currently being produced.The power transformer is a completely sealed type that was jointly developed by tamura Manufacturing Co., Ltd., as well as other amplifiers at Uesugi Research Laboratories.The circuit configuration is a 3-stage NF type. sections.title: UESUGI U-BROS-5
sections.overview:
88,000 (released in 1979)  92,400 (around 2007)

A step-up transformer for MC cartridges developed to bring out all the attractiveness of MC cartridges.In order to prevent the deterioration of the separation characteristics, the left and right completely independent structure is adopted. Not only the signal system including the transformer but also the ground system are designed to be completely independent on the left and right.The chassis ground of the main unit is grounded from the main unit of the control amplifier.A specially designed transformer developed jointly by Uesugi R & D Laboratories and tamura Manufacturing Co., Ltd. is used for the transformer. The core material of the transformer is ultra-thin special permalloy to obtain excellent characteristics. Moreover, by driving the high-frequency peak into the band of 100 kHz or more, the coloring of the transformer itself is suppressed.As a countermeasure against induction hum, the chassis is made of special grade iron, the transformer is made of multiple shield structure, and the transformer is floated in a large copper plated iron case.In addition, we have incorporated our unique know-how in signal line routing in order to suppress magnetic distortion caused by iron materials.In order to eliminate the sound quality degradation caused by the impedance switching, two types of low impedance type and high impedance type are available.The L type has a primary impedance of 3   and the H type has a primary impedance of 40  . The L type is suitable for MC cartridges with low impedance design of Orthophone series. The H type is suitable for MC cartridges with high impedance design of Torrance, EMT, Denon, etc.Both types are designed with a high margin, and L type is suitable for 3 ~ 10   cartridge and H type is suitable for 10 ~ 40   cartridge.

sections.title: UESUGI U-BROS-22
sections.overview: AC power supplier that cleans 100 VAC commercial power supply.Due to the widespread use of digital equipment, it is possible to suppress the degradation of playback sound by cutting off various noise signals that flow into the 100 VAC commercial power supply.The U ? BROS-22 uses a series filter method as a noise cut method.In this method, a filter consisting of a coil and a capacitor is installed in series with the AC line to eliminate noise signals. In addition, the series filter method is mainly operated in the high-frequency signal region. According to the results of hearing tests, the series filter method cuts the band above 100 VAC / 60 Hz.The power line for analog audio equipment at the Line 5 AC outlet consists of two low-resistance / high-current choke coils with a built-in low-pass filter that provides 0 attenuation at 50Hz/60Hz, - 3 dB attenuation at 500 Hz, and sharp cut-off at higher frequencies.The power line for digital audio equipment at the Route 3 AC outlet has a built-in low-pass filter that cuts out high-frequency noise signals.The AC outlet of the Line 5 for analog audio equipment and the Route 3 for digital audio equipment can be turned ON/OFF independently by the sub power switch installed on the front panel.The master power switch on the left side of the panel allows you to simultaneously turn on / off the power for a total of eight AC outlets.The ON/OFF status of these power supplies is indicated by the pilot lamp above the power switch located on the front panel.The total capacity available from each AC outlet is 1000 VA instantly and 500 VA continuously.

sections.title: UESUGI UT-50
sections.overview:
* Limited production of 400 units  500,000 (Released in September 2002)

Tube bulb type pre-main amplifier using vacuum tubes manufactured in the heyday of vacuum tubes.An NFB-type preamplifier with a gain of approximately 14 dB is equipped with four input selectors, a recording monitor and a volume controller.The practical hum level is out of detection by using DC ignition for the heater of all voltage amplification stages except for the power amplification part as well as the preamplifier part.A Mulard type push-pull system is used for the power amplifier section. For NFB, a dedicated NFB coil is installed in the output transformer, and approximately 14 dB of NFB is applied from the coil to the cathode of the first stage tube of the power amplifier section.6L6l6GC is used for the push-pull type power amplifier stage, and the 3-pole tube characteristics are obtained as an ultra-linear connection rather than the original beam-tube connection. In addition, the 6L6GC has excellent self-bias operation in terms of stability, and high reliability is ensured by installing only one bias circuit in one 6L6GC. This 6L6GC can obtain a power of 50W or more in push-pull operation, but it operates at 22W + 22W in consideration of reliability and long life.ECC83 and ECC82 made by Siemens (Germany) are used for the voltage amplification stage, and 6L6GC made by General Electric (US) is used for the output tube.The transformer, power transformer and choke coil are all custom-made by tamura.Even if unbalanced current flows through the power amplifier tube, the output transformer has a constant inductance design with less fluctuation in the primary inductance of the output transformer, and there is no adjustment circuit.In order to eliminate the inherent sound caused by the printed circuit board, manual wiring by veteran craftsmen is adopted.Uses a newly developed hardened copper pinpoint foot with 3-point support. In addition, the pin and tray are integrated with the body bottom plate.Equipped with a stainless bar cover.Uses WBT speaker terminal (WBT-0735).Four input terminals and one input / output terminal are installed.The impedance of the speaker is 8   to 16  .The UT-50 is also used as a reference for Tannoy.

sections.title: UESUGI U-BROS-JUNIOR-2
sections.overview:
Up to 100 units :   220,000 (around 1995)After the 100th :   230,000 (around 1995)

A stereo line input controller was developed to meet the demand for a "fader box that uses a digital source as the main source, does not require any gain, and does not degrade sound quality in the high range."The basic structure is a 0 dB gain version of the U ? BORS-18. This fader box has been developed with the aim of eliminating sound quality degradation caused by volume changes.In the U ? BROS ? JUNIOR-2, the signal that passes through the input selector and the tape monitor switch enters the volume controller of the attenuator. The signal passes through a noise reduction filter and is directed to a cathode follower amplifier composed of vacuum tube ECC83/12A.This cathode follower amplifier is equipped with a high-stability circuit to achieve stable operation. In addition, the vacuum tube heater is double-wave-rectified, and a   - type filter is installed to provide DC ignition, which suppresses heater hum.In the cathode follower amplifier, there is a concern about the breakdown voltage between the cathode and the heater because the cathode becomes high voltage. This problem is prevented by applying the same DC bias as the cathode potential to the heater.A vacuum tube is used for the impedance converter.In addition, against leakage flux of the power transformer that supplies power to the vacuum tube, a shielding technique has been introduced and the design is ham free and noise free.For the coupling capacitor of the signal passing system, we use a film capacitor with sufficient damping measures, and we also take sound quality measures for resistors to improve sound quality.In order to prevent the power transformer from becoming expensive, airtight structure is avoided, and measures against leakage flux are taken by installing a ham proof belt and short ring.The input selector consists of a 5-position rotary switch. One balanced input and four unbalanced inputs can be selected.The balanced input consists of a transformer designed to take into account digital sources in the era of high sampling frequencies. Like other amplifiers developed by Uesugi R & D Laboratories, this transformer uses a specially designed product jointly developed with tamura Manufacturing Co., Ltd., and the casing is simplified to prevent it from becoming expensive.In consideration of sound quality, it does not use a printed circuit board but uses manual wiring by skilled craftsmen.The front panel is finished with champagne gold hairline processing using aluminum drawn material, the knob is finished with champagne gold spin processing using aluminum shaved material, and the wood case is finished with cheek material.

sections.overview: This preamp was developed based on the idea that "by passing it through the preamp, you want to obtain a fresh and glossy sound without feeling of stimulation."A transformer is used for the balance input. The high-frequency characteristics of the transformer used here are flat responses up to 130 kHz in consideration of compatibility with next-generation audio sources extending up to approximately 100 kHz.ECC83/12AX7 vacuum used for the vacuum tube, and characteristics are improved by making it a shunt regulated push-pull operation, and characteristics are further improved by multiplying the input by NFB of approximately 20 dB from the output.The U ? BROS-28 is designed to best match a transistor-type power amplifier with an input impedance of 10k   or k   or therefore, it can be combined with a transistor-type power amplifier with the exception of some special ones.Both the high voltage circuit and the low voltage circuit (for heater) of the power supply have been passed through a sufficient ripple filter to suppress the hum component.A total condenser of 330 ? F is used for the high voltage circuit.The recording monitor mechanism has a defeat position and is designed to be used in the defeat position except for recording and playback on a recording device.The ECC83/12AX7 is manufactured by the K. The lug plate is fixed to a 1.6 mm thick plated metal base with a reinforced structure to prevent vibration.The wiring is done manually by veteran craftsmen.The signal transmission amplifier system and power supply system are equipped with various filters to eliminate muddy sound and irritating sound.

sections.overview: A preamplifier developed as an amplifier paired with U ? BROS-30.The phono equalizer circuit uses a 2-stage P-K NF type, which provides excellent physical characteristics with a simple circuit. In addition, by increasing the voltage supplied to the phono equalizer circuit, the dynamic range in the high-frequency range is kept high.The tone controller is an NF type with excellent physical characteristics.The tone controller of the U ? sections.title: UESUGI UTY-12
sections.overview:
* Limited production of 200 units  330,000 (released in 1994)

A preamplifier that was introduced as a pair with the power amplifier UTY-11 in order to let many people know the sound of UESUGI AMP.Only 200 units were produced for both UTY-11 and UTY-12.The UTY-12 is basically designed and developed based on the same concept as the U ? BROS-18, and the balance input terminal of the two systems is a transformer type like the U ? BROS-18.In the amplifier circuit section, the flat amplifier is a 2-stage NF amplifier using ECC83/12AX7, and the NFB of the minor loop is applied to each of the preceding and succeeding stages to reduce the amount of NFB in the total major loop. This eliminates the peculiarity of sound caused by excessive application of NFB.The ECC83/12AX7 is manufactured by the K. K. Electron Tube Division of Matsushita Electric Industrial Co., Ltd. in accordance with the specifications of Uesugi R & D Laboratories during the heyday of vacuum tubes. The ECC83/12AX7 is even more carefully selected.A ripple filter circuit is provided for both the high voltage power supply circuit and the heater power supply circuit.By developing and using a power transformer with a multiple shield structure and tightening the chassis internal shield, the power supply section is brought closer to the amplifier section and interference from the power supply section is suppressed.The chassis structure consists of two blocks, a main chassis and a sub-chassis. The input and output systems are integrated into the main chassis, and the amplifier and power supply are integrated into a shielded sub-chassis.A lug plate is used for the wiring. The lug plate is firmly fixed to a 1.6 mm thick plated metal base with a reinforced structure to prevent vibration.The wiring work is done manually by veteran craftsmen.The volume controller is received by a 2-stage NF amplifier that can ensure high input impedance. In addition, no shield wire is used for the wire on the slider side of the volume controller and the distance is the shortest to prevent changes in sound quality and timbre caused by volume changes.There is a mechanism called signal off in the position of the tape monitor switch.The power transformer and balance input transformer are jointly developed by Uesugi Research Laboratories and tamura Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

sections.title: UESUGI U-BROS-17
sections.overview: As a successor to the U ? BROS-11, this monaural power amplifier has been further refined to enhance its perfection.The first stage consists of parallel connection of ECC83/12AX7, the first stage and driver / phase inversion stage are cathode connection type, the balls used are ECC82/12AU7, and the power stage consists of EL34/6CA7 3-pole tube connection parallel push-pull.In U ? BORS-11, the first stage tube was connected in parallel with ECC82/12AU7. In U ? BROS-17, this tube is connected in parallel with ECC83/12AX7 and the amount of NFB is set at 14 dB. This improves the total SN ratio and stability.The vacuum tubes used in the push-pull circuit are carefully selected matched pair tubes with the same current value after being sufficiently aged by an aging machine specially made by Uesugi Research Institute. This eliminates the DC balance circuit.In addition, the output transformer is designed so that the primary inductance is almost constant so that there is no problem in the characteristics even if there is variation in a set of two vacuum tubes constituting the push-pull.The power supply section uses a choke coil with large inductance to obtain clean DC output and DC current, and the DC resistance of the power transformer and choke coil is reduced as much as possible to keep the supply voltage constant at all outputs.Two parallel inputs are provided, and bi-amp drive system is also available.Transformers developed jointly by Uesugi R & D Laboratories and tamura Manufacturing Co., Ltd. are used for these transformers. The terminal and casing of these transformers are designed with high reliability equivalent to the specifications for space satellites.Vacuum tubes were manufactured in the heyday of vacuum tubes, and after being sufficiently aged by a special aging machine, they are carefully selected and used.Wiring is divided into each block such as power supply lock, bias block, and amplification stage block.Since the level controller is located immediately near the first stage tube, no shield wire is used for the wiring to the level controller, and the distance is the shortest, there is no sound quality change by adjusting the level controller.The wiring is hand-made by skilled craftsmen.The chassis is a hand-made finish with rounded corners by bending a 1.6 mm thick high-grade iron material and then applying solder to all the welded parts and polishing.In addition, the entire body is finished in metallic and phase to harmonize with the hammer tone transformer case.In the U ? BROS-11, the catalog display power was 30W, but in the U ? BROS-17, even with the same EL34/6CA7, it uses the EL34/6CA7 made by GE Corporation of America, which has a higher margin, so a large output of 40W is achieved.The four parallel push-pull power tubes are arranged asymmetrically on the positive-phase side and the negative-phase side with respect to the output transformer arrangement in order to eliminate the disadvantage of "the parallel push-pull is slightly blurred."

sections.title: UESUGI U-BROS-21
sections.overview: This monaural power amplifier was developed as a continuing product in response to the popularity of the limited 300B amplifier UTY-10.The basic configuration is the same as that of the UTY-10, the chassis is slightly larger to provide more space for parts layout, and the 300B filament rectifying circuit and high-voltage rectifying circuit in the power supply section are enhanced.The circuitry consists of an ECC83 top stage, an ECC83 P-K split phase inverter stage, an ECC82 push-pull driver stage, and a 300B self-bias push-pull power stage.The ECC83 direct-coupled circuit achieves stable operation by supplying a sufficient bleeder current to stabilize the power supply.The power supply section is bridge rectifier using a high-reliability diode. Since the power tube is 300B, a direct-heating 3-pole output tube, an indirectly heating 2-pole tube called 5AR4/GZ34 is used for the power supply system to prevent high voltage from being generated immediately after the switch is turned on.The Golden Dragon / 300B adopted in the output tube basically uses GD300B Super.In U ? BROS-21, this GD300B Super is aged in an aging machine made by Uesugi Research Institute, and only carefully selected products are used after sorting through performance tests.For the ECC83 and ECC82 MT tubes, we use highly reliable national-brand tubes that were specially ordered from the K. K. Electron Tube Division of Matsushita Electric Industrial Co., Ltd. in the latter half of the 1965 s based on the specifications of Uesugi Research Laboratories.For the 5AR4/GZ34 parathermal bipolar tube, we have selected highly reliable tubes made in Russia and manufactured for military use.The transformer uses high-quality products jointly developed by Uesugi R & D Laboratories and tamura Manufacturing Co., Ltd., and the terminal and casing of the transformer are designed for high reliability equivalent to strict standards for space satellites.The output transformer has a primary winding to load the power tube, a secondary winding to connect to the speaker system, and an NFB tertiary winding for the main loop.Wiring is used for each block such as power supply block, bias block, and amplification stage block.In addition, the level controller is placed close to the first stage tube, and no shield wire is used for the wiring to the level controller and the shortest wiring is used. Therefore, the sound quality does not change due to the adjustment of the level controller.The wiring work is hand-made by skilled craftsmen.The U ? BROS-21 is designed to be compact and compact without pushing too much.The output transformer is located on the left side of the front, and the power transformer is located on the right side. Two large 300B tubes are placed in the center, and three vacuum tubes, ECC82/12AU7, ECC83/12AX7 and 5AR4/GZ34, are placed in the rear.The rear large cover contains three large capacitors, a choke coil, and a 300B filament rectifying circuit. The cover contains a 4-mm-thick aluminum plate that dumps the resonance from the inside, determined by a thorough hearing test.

sections.title: UESUGI U-BROS-23
sections.overview: As a successor to the U ? BROS-15, this is a monaural power amplifier that achieves both high quality and high power.The U ? BROS-23 uses an output transformer, which was jointly developed by Uesugi R & D Laboratories and tamura Manufacturing Co., Ltd. over a period of three years, thereby achieving both high quality and high power.This output transformer has a primary winding to load the power tube, a secondary winding to connect to the speaker system, an NFB tertiary winding for the main loop, and a cathode feedback fourth winding for the power tube.The power tube uses EL34/6CA7 of GE Inc. of the United States, which has a large maximum rating. By operating this in parallel push-pull operation, approximately twice the theoretical power is obtained. The cathode feedback is applied to the cathode of the power tube from the fourth winding dedicated to the cathode feedback of the output transformer, so that both high power and high quality are achieved.The EL34/6CA7 can take out high power by operating at a high voltage of around 800 v without using parallel push-pull operation. However, in consideration of safety and stability, the EL34/6CA7 uses parallel push-pull operation.The phase inverter and driver consists of a cathode composite type with ECC82/12AU7 with stable characteristics, and the power stage consists of parallel push-pull and cathode negative feedback connection of EL34/6CA7.In addition, the ECC83/12AX7 is designed to reduce the device design by supplying sufficient bleeder current so that the performance will not be disturbed or operation will not become unstable due to the dispersion of the ECC83/12AX7.We use vacuum tubes manufactured in the heyday of vacuum tubes. These vacuum tubes are sufficiently aged by an aging machine specially made by Uesugi Research Institute, and then carefully selected and used.The chassis has a unique hand-made finish with a 1.6 mm thick high-grade iron material that is bent and then solder is poured into all the welded parts and polished to create R at the four corners.Wiring is used for each block such as power supply lock / bias block / amplification stage block.In addition, the level controller is placed close to the first stage tube, and no shield wire is used for the wiring from the level controller, and the shortest wiring is used. This reduces the change in sound quality caused by the adjustment of the level controller.It is hand-made by skilled craftsmen using the UESUGI method of wiring.

sections.title: UESUGI U-BROS-33
sections.overview: While maintaining the quality of U ? BROS-15 and U ? BROS-23, this monaural power amplifier achieves low price by reducing the power to half that of U ? BROS-23.By maintaining a high balance between the two primary windings of the output transformer and a high push-pull balance between the driver stage and the power stage, the low-level quality is improved.The basic circuit is Mulard type, the power stage is push-pull type with EL34/6CA7, and NFB is applied to the cathode of the power stage from the special winding of the output transformer. This circuit achieves both the sound quality of the 3-pole tube and the high efficiency of the multi-pole tube.It is designed to take advantage of the good aspects of NFB by applying 12 dB NFB by over-all. In addition to this, the amplifier stage is designed to have low impedance, an output transformer with excellent phase characteristics is used, and phase correction is applied so that wide-range distortion characteristics do not deteriorate.The maximum output B current of the U ? BROS-33 is approximately 300 mA, while the B power supply of the power transformer can take out 400 mA. Thus, the design has a high margin.The Lipps filter circuit consists of a low-internal resistance choke coil and a high-capacity capacitor, which not only eliminates hum components but also helps eliminate harmful noise signals coming from the AC power supply.The vacuum tubes of U / BROS-33 are made by GE Corporation in the US.Transformers are standardized as transformers jointly developed with tamura Manufacturing.All parts used are designed for sound quality and high reliability. Resistors with large W and capacitors with high withstand voltage are used.The wiring is done by hand using lug plates, and it is done by a veteran with a long history of wiring.The chassis has a unique hand-made finish with a 1.6 mm thick SECC (bonderized steel plate) that is bent and processed, then solder is poured into all the welds and polished to create four rounded corners.

sections.title: UESUGI U-BROS-24
sections.overview: This is a stereo power amplifier with low cost by adopting a stereo configuration.In order to reduce the cost without lowering the quality of the parts, it is basically a parallel push-pull of U ? BROS-23 and a stereo version.The power stage uses the EL34/6CA7 manufactured by Siemens in the West German era. The EL34/6CA7 is operated in a push-pull operation, and NFB is uniformly and stably supplied from the dedicated winding of the output transformer to each cathode. Thus, the excellent quality of the 3-pole tube and the high power characteristics of the multi-pole tube are compatible.The first stage uses ECC83/12AX7/7025A with excellent SN ratio under low load, and the phase inversion stage is a cathode coupled type with ECC82/12AU7.12 dB of NFB is applied to the cathode of the first stage from the NFB-dedicated winding of the output transformer. This feedback amount is determined to be the best match with each speaker system by loading the horn type or dome type.Although the circuit configuration has been completely simplified, phase correction is still required because there are two time constants in the low frequency range and three time constants in the high frequency range. high-frequency range. The U ? BROS-24 uses an output transformer that can ensure a large primary inductance in the low-frequency range and minimizes fluctuations in the primary inductance. It also improves the phase characteristics of the output transformer to the utmost and uses a unique differential and integral type phase correction circuit to achieve extremely stable NFB application over the whole round fractional band.The U ? BROS-24 vacuum tubes are carefully selected matched pair tubes with the same current value after being sufficiently aged with an aging machine specially made by Uesugi Research Institute. In addition, the output transformer is designed so that the primary inductance is almost constant, even if there is a variation in characteristics of the pair of two vacuum tubes constituting the push-pull.This eliminates the DC balance circuit.The power supply part is designed with an extremely high margin, and heat generation from the power transformer is kept low for practical use.The power supply circuit uses a large-capacity power transformer and a choke coil instead of a constant current circuit. The capacity of the capacitor is determined by hearing test and stability based on pulse waveform.4  , 8  , and 16   Route 3 outputs are provided.In addition, since the optimum load curve is designed to be very broad, even if an 8   speaker system is connected to the 4   output terminal of the amplifier, there is no particular mis-matching.High-quality transformers developed jointly by Uesugi Research Laboratories and tamura Manufacturing Co., Ltd. are used.The output transformer has a primary winding to load the power tube, a secondary winding to connect to the speaker system, an NFB tertiary winding for the main loop, and a cathode feed back fourth winding for the power tube.Wiring is used for each block such as power supply block, bias block, and amplification stage block.In addition, the level controller is placed close to the first stage tube, and no shield wire is used for the wiring to the level controller, and the shortest wiring is used. Thus, the sound quality degradation caused by the level controller adjustment is suppressed.The wiring is hand-made by skilled craftsmen.The chassis has a unique hand-made finish in which high grade iron material of 1.6 mm thickness is bent and processed, then solder is poured into all the welded parts and polished to create R at the 4 corners.All vacuum tubes were manufactured in the heyday of vacuum tubes.The front of the chassis is equipped with two input selectors, a level controller for left and right linkage, and a power switch.

sections.title: UESUGI U-BROS-32
sections.overview: This is a stereo power amplifier developed as a successor to U ? BROS-27.The power tube uses EL34/6CA7 made by GE Corporation in the US, which was manufactured in the heyday of vacuum tubes. This is operated as an ultra-linear connection and NFB is applied in overall.The first stage tube and driver tube are made of 6189W (ECC82/12AU7 high-reliability tube) with low internal resistance to obtain excellent high-frequency characteristics, and have a 3-stage configuration. In addition, the first stage tube and driver tube are connected directly and the time constant in the low-frequency range is set to two stages to improve stability in the low-frequency range.In the overall system, the NFB is returned from the third winding of the dedicated winding to the cathode of the first stage tube to maintain stability.Transformers developed jointly by Uesugi Research Laboratories and tamura Manufacturing Co., Ltd. are used.Both GE/EL34 and Philips ECG/6189W vacuum tubes were manufactured in the heyday of vacuum tubes. These tubes are aged in an aging machine made by Uesugi Research Institute and carefully selected for use.The chassis has a unique hand-made finish with a 1.6 mm thick SECC (bonderized steel plate) that is bent and processed, then solder is poured into all the welds and polished to create four rounded corners.The level controller is located close to the first stage tube, so that no shield wire is used for the wiring from the level controller and the shortest wiring is used, thereby suppressing the change in the high-frequency characteristics due to the adjustment of the level controller.UESUGI method of wiring is adopted, and the wiring is hand-made by skilled craftsmen.The single system has the disadvantage that it is difficult to keep the inductance of the primary coil high because direct current flows in the primary coil of the output transformer, and as a result, it is difficult to obtain a large scale bass.The U ? BROS-32 compensates for the disadvantages of a single amplifier by increasing the core volume and increasing the inductance of the primary coil.

sections.title: UESUGI U-BROS-1K
sections.overview:
This tube type power amplifier kit was released to commemorate the launch of "Tube Kingdom" by Stereo Sound Company.Based on the concept of "Let as many people as possible enjoy the goodness of vacuum tube type amplifier," the development design is orthodox, and high performance, high stability and high reliability are compatible.In order to be able to use it by directly connecting a CD player, a level set volume is provided independently on the left and right sides for the input.A 0.47 ? F capacitor is installed at the output of the 100k   vari-ohm. This capacitor stops the inflow of the grid current of the vacuum tube and prevents the generation of garry noise each time the level is adjusted.The top stage vacuum tube uses ECC83/12AX7, which has an excellent signal-to-noise ratio.A current of approximately 0.2 mA flows through this top stage, and a current of approximately 10 times this value is supplied by the bleeder, so it can operate stably even if it is replaced with another ECC83/12AX7.ECC82/12AU7 is used for the phase inverter and driver stage following the top stage. It is directly connected to the top stage to eliminate the time constant in the low frequency range. This method is called the Leak Malard type, and it was also used in the Marantz and Macintosh in the past.In this driver stage, the supply voltage is set to 320 v based on the relationship between the supply voltage and the life of the vacuum tube, and the balance between the clipping waveform at maximum output.The driver stage and power stage are CR-coupled for stability, and the power stage is the first self-bias type of push-pull amplifier at Uesugi Research Laboratories.It is said that this is because they wanted to avoid critical adjustment because it is a kit, and they considered the merit that the bias value becomes deep and self-defensive instinct works when a runaway large current flows in the power tube due to some kind of trouble.An enamel type resistor is used for this bias resistor, and by making it larger than necessary at 30W, extremely stable operation is realized.The power stage uses 6L6WGC, which has the highest rating among the 6L6 series, the origin of the beam tube, and operates as an ultra-linear connection.The matching impedance of the output terminal is designed as 6-ohm only, and this impedance value can be used for 4 - to 8-ohm speakers to improve cost performance.An overall negative feed back of approximately 13 dB is applied with high stability from the output terminal of the output transformer to the cathode of the top stage to improve various characteristics as a power amplifier for driving the speaker system.The power supply circuit uses a choke coil with sufficient inductance as a push-pull amplifier because it not only reduces the residual noise level, but also eliminates harmonic components from the residual noise waveform and effectively eliminates noise / hum even when combined with a high-efficiency speaker system.In addition, the high-voltage rectification is bridged by a diode with excellent stability and reliability, and noise countermeasures for the diode are made perfect by isolating the diode itself in a corner of the chassis.Transformers developed jointly by Uesugi Research Laboratories and tamura Manufacturing Co., Ltd. are used.The output transformer of the U ? BROS-1/K is designed to ensure a sufficient core volume to obtain good low-frequency characteristics, and to minimize the fluctuation of primary inductance even if the DC balance of the power tube is lost, to obtain stable low-frequency characteristics as an NF amplifier. It also has features such as smooth high-frequency phase characteristics.

          The vacuum tube uses the Russian / Sovtek brand 6L6WGC power tube. This 6L6WGC was manufactured for military use. It has solid electrodes structure and high performance and high reliability.
          The ECC83 and ECC82 are from the UK Blastton brand, while the ECC83 is manufactured in Russia and the ECC82 is manufactured in China, making them Blastton's selection balls.The chassis is made by a manufacturer in Kobe that manufactures Defense Agency standard products such as precision sheet metal Hyogo Radio K. K. and paint K. K. Bansho.In the chassis layout, the signal amplifier section, through which audio signals directly flow, is laid out so that conditions such as left and right channels are satisfied, thereby suppressing mutual interference.Although it is a kit, in order to realize a high degree of perfection, the part that the user wires is only the lead wire of transformers.

sections.title: UESUGI U-BROS-2K
sections.overview: A tube type preamplifier kit developed as an amplifier to be paired with U ? BROS-1/K in response to the request of users who purchased U ? BROS-1/K.The U ? BROS-2/K takes measures against external noise signals in consideration of the influence of 100 VAC commercial power supply system and air-borne radio wave system, which have deteriorated due to the spread of electronic devices.The mechanism design is based on the know-how of the U ? BROS-20 phono equalizer amplifier with a built-in power supply. The power transformer and diode are placed at the optimum position and two shield plates are placed at the effective position. Thus, while the power supply is designed with a built-in power supply, interference from the power supply to the amplifier is shut out.The chassis structure consists of two blocks, a main chassis and a sub-chassis. The input and output systems are integrated into the main chassis, and the power supply and amplifier are integrated into a sub-chassis with perfect shielding.In addition, by arranging the amplifier symmetrically, the operation of the left and right channels is made equal condition.The knobs on the front panel are laid out from right to left along the signal flow, and the knobs on the frequently used volume controller are made larger in an orthodox way.Aluminum pull-out material is used for the various knobs and front panel, champagne gold hairline finish for the front panel, champagne gold spin finish for the knobs, and solid teak sidewood for the side of the chassis.On the rear panel, there are two switched / AC outlets and one unswitched / AC outlet in addition to the Line 5 input and two outputs.The rotary switch uses a highly reliable design specification to prevent distortion (diode distortion / detection distortion) that causes a sense of interstimulus due to poor contact, thereby preventing deterioration of sound quality caused by the switch.Capacitors and resistors are specially designed for high precision, high margin, and high reliability by Uesugi Research Laboratories.In order to reduce the price, the power transformer is a band type rather than a sealed type. This transformer has a ham-proof belt and short ring to reduce leakage flux.As with other Uesugi products, this power transformer uses a product jointly developed with tamura Manufacturing.The top stage uses a low-noise ball manufactured by Matsushita Electric Industrial K. K. / Electron Tube Division in accordance with Uesugi's strict special specifications during the heyday of vacuum tubes. This special low-noise ball is more stable than the genuine Telefunken ball manufactured during the heyday of vacuum tubes.The phono input and various line-level inputs are protected against high-frequency noise signals to achieve more natural sound quality.The phono equalizer amplifier uses a 2-stage / P-K NF type.The amplification factor of the flat amplifier (line amplifier) section is set to 14 dB (5 times) in consideration of the output of the phono equalizer amplifier and the output of the CD player. This flat amplifier is a 1-stage P-G type NF type that takes advantage of only the good side of NFB in order to unify the gain of the left and right channels as well as the phono equalizer amplifier.In order to reduce the input impedance, which is a disadvantage of the 1-stage P-G NF type, we have taken measures such as increasing the grid resistance to a certain extent to lighten the load on the equipment connected to the input, and eliminating the shield wire of the grid circuit to prevent the degradation of the high-frequency characteristics.The power supply has a multi-stage configuration of an orthodox   - type filter with a CR element.U ? BROS-2/K does not use a shield wire on the slider side of the volume controller.In this way, a high-cut filter is constructed by using a shield wire on the slider side of the volume. The problem is solved.In order to achieve a high level of perfection even in the kit, most of the circuits are already wired and only the transformer leads are wired.It can be used as a single phono equalizer amplifier.In this case, leave the Input Selector switch in the phono position and the Tape Monitor switch in the IN position, and take the signal from the rear panel Tape / Recording Output output jack.
